items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I worked at Packy McFarland's After Hour Club

ctx.x: Before we go on to the '40's.

Now, wait. Let me get -- this says -- still in Chicago, before New York, I've got this down. Let me see. Between times I recorded with Lovie, Tommy Ladnier. Oh, I played the Regal Theater in Chicago -- Regal Theater, still in Chicago. I worked at Packy McFarland's After Hour Club, and there's when I went to the Burnham Inn. Got that?
